P1.name: Phuket Smart Bus
P1.summary: Airport → Surin → Kamala → Patong → Karon → Kata → Rawai
P1.boarding: Domestic terminal, exit 3. Turn left and look for the blue bus sign opposite Café Amazon.
P1.noteOut: Every 30 minutes for most of the day. The 14:00, 15:00 and 16:00 buses continue past Rawai to Phromthep Cape.
P1.noteIn: Five early runs start at Kata Palm instead of Rawai: 05:20, 06:20, 07:45, 08:45 and 09:45.

P2.name: Airport Bus 8411
P2.summary: Airport → Heroines Monument → Central Phuket → Phuket Town → Bus Terminal 1
P2.boarding: Outside the domestic terminal exit, on the left. From international arrivals, walk over to the domestic side.
P2.noteOut: This bus does not go to Patong, Karon or Kata.
P2.lastBusConflict: The operator's timetable shows a 22:30 bus from the airport, but its own FAQ says the last one leaves at 21:30. If you land late, don't count on the 22:30.

P3.name: Airport Bus Express
P3.boarding: Airport bus parking near exit 3. Turn left; the bus waits beside the ramp.
P3.fareUnconfirmed: We could not confirm the current fare. Sources from 2025 give anything from 100฿ to 220฿. Ask the staff before you board, or message the operator on WhatsApp ({whatsapp}).
P3.websiteDown: The operator's old website now sends visitors to an ad page. Its Facebook page is still active (last post October 2026).

P4.name: Smart Bus Route 2
P4.summary: Bus Terminal 1 → Bangkok Hospital → Kathu → Patong
P4.boarding: Phuket Bus Terminal 1, platform 11. In Patong, the Patong Beach bus stop.
P4.noteIn: About 70 minutes back to Bus Terminal 1. A separate hourly shuttle links Bus Terminal 1 and Bus Terminal 2 (05:00–19:30).

P5.name: Dragon Line
P5.summary: Free loop around Phuket Old Town from PKCD Parking
P5.boarding: Starts at PKCD Parking in Phuket Old Town. You can board at any marked stop on the loop.
P5.note: Free, every 30 minutes from 07:00 to 19:00, according to the operator's route map. Stop order is approximate.

P1.title: Phuket Smart Bus Timetable 2026: Airport to Patong, Kata, Rawai
P1.description: Phuket Smart Bus (light blue): about every 30 min from the airport, {fare} to any stop. Times at Patong, Karon, Kata and Rawai, and where to board.
P1.h1: Phuket Smart Bus: airport to Patong, Kata and Rawai
P1.intro: The Smart Bus is the light blue and white bus on the west coast. It runs from Phuket Airport through Surin, Kamala, Patong, Karon and Kata to Rawai. It costs {fare} to any stop and leaves the airport about every 30 minutes, from {first} until {last}.

faq.q: How much is the Smart Bus from Phuket Airport?
faq.a: {fare} to any stop. Children under 6 ride free. Pay on board in cash, by QR or with a contactless card.

faq.q: Where is the Smart Bus stop at Phuket Airport?
faq.a: {boarding}

faq.q: How long does it take to Patong, Kata or Rawai?
faq.a: By the operator's timetable, about {patong} to Patong, {kata} to Kata and {rawai} to Rawai. Allow extra time in traffic.

faq.q: What time are the first and last buses?
faq.a: From the airport: first {first}, last {last}. From Rawai to the airport: first {inFirst}, last {inLast}. Earlier runs start at Kata Palm from {kataFirst}.

faq.q: Which blue bus is the Smart Bus?
faq.a: The Smart Bus is light blue and white. The darker blue bus is the Airport Bus Express, a different company with a different fare.

faq.q: Is there a day pass?
faq.a: Yes, sold on the bus: {passes}.

P2.title: Phuket Airport Bus 8411 to Phuket Town: Timetable & Fare 2026
P2.description: Orange airport bus 8411 to Phuket Town: {fare}, about {duration}. Departures {first}–{last}, where to board, and how to reach Patong.
P2.h1: Airport Bus 8411: Phuket Airport to Phuket Town
P2.intro: The orange 8411 bus runs from Phuket Airport down the middle of the island to Phuket Town and Bus Terminal 1. Fares go by distance ({fare}), and the full ride takes about {duration}.

faq.q: How much is the airport bus to Phuket Town?
faq.a: {max}฿ to Phuket Town. Shorter rides cost less: {steps}.

faq.q: Where do I catch the 8411 at Phuket Airport?
faq.a: {boarding}

faq.q: Does the 8411 go to Patong?
faq.a: No. Change at Bus Terminal 1 to Smart Bus Route 2: {p4fare}, about {p4time} to Patong. Or take the Smart Bus from the airport, which goes straight to Patong.

faq.q: What time are the first and last buses?
faq.a: From the airport: first {first}, last {last}. From Bus Terminal 1: first {inFirst}, last {inLast}.

P3.title: Phuket Airport Bus Express to Patong, Karon, Kata: Times 2026
P3.description: Dark blue Airport Bus Express, Phuket Airport to Patong, Karon and Kata: departures {first}–{last} and where to board. Fare unconfirmed.
P3.h1: Airport Bus Express: Phuket Airport to Patong, Karon and Kata
P3.intro: The dark blue Airport Bus Express runs from the airport through Kathu to Patong, Karon and Kata, leaving every hour from {first} to {last}.

faq.q: How much is the Airport Bus Express?
faq.a: {fareNote}

faq.q: Where do I catch it at Phuket Airport?
faq.a: {boarding}

faq.q: What time are the first and last buses?
faq.a: From the airport: first {first}, last {last}. Back to the airport: first {inFirst}, last {inLast}.

faq.q: Is it the same as the Smart Bus?
faq.a: No. It is a different company with a different fare and a darker blue bus. The Smart Bus ({p1fare}) also goes to Patong, Karon and Kata, about every 30 minutes.

P4.title: Phuket Town to Patong Bus (Smart Bus Route 2): Timetable 2026
P4.description: Smart Bus Route 2 between Phuket Bus Terminal 1 and Patong: {fare}, about {duration}, platform 11. Full timetable both ways and day passes.
P4.h1: Phuket Town to Patong by bus
P4.intro: Smart Bus Route 2 links Phuket Bus Terminal 1 in town with Patong Beach through Kathu. It costs {fare} and takes about {duration} to Patong.

faq.q: How much is the bus from Phuket Town to Patong?
faq.a: {fare}, paid on board in cash or by QR.

faq.q: Where does it leave from?
faq.a: {boarding}

faq.q: What time are the first and last buses?
faq.a: From Bus Terminal 1: first {first}, last {last}. From Patong: first {inFirst}, last {inLast}.

faq.q: Does it go to the airport?
faq.a: No. From the airport, take the orange 8411 bus to Bus Terminal 1 and change there, or take the Smart Bus straight to Patong.

faq.q: Is there a day pass?
faq.a: Yes, sold on the bus: {passes}.

P5.title: Dragon Line: Free Phuket Old Town Bus, Route & Hours 2026
P5.description: The Dragon Line is a free electric bus looping Phuket Old Town every {every} min, {start}–{end}. Stops, where to start and how it links to other buses.
P5.h1: Dragon Line: the free Old Town bus
P5.intro: The Dragon Line is a free electric shuttle that loops around Phuket Old Town. Phuket Smart Bus runs it with Phuket City Development (PKCD). It leaves every {every} minutes from {start} to {end}.

faq.q: Is the Dragon Line really free?
faq.a: Yes. There is no fare.

faq.q: What are the hours?
faq.a: Every {every} minutes from {start} to {end}, according to the operator's route map.

faq.q: Where does it start?
faq.a: {boarding}

faq.q: Does it go to the airport or the beaches?
faq.a: No. It only loops the Old Town. For Patong, take Smart Bus Route 2 from Bus Terminal 1.

patong.title: Patong Bus Guide 2026: Airport to Patong, Patong to Phuket Town
patong.description: Buses to and from Patong: Smart Bus from the airport ({p1fare}, about {p1time}), Airport Express, and the {p4fare} bus to Phuket Town. Times and stops.
patong.h1: Getting to and from Patong by bus
patong.intro: Patong has two direct bus links: one to the airport and one to Phuket Town. Here is every option, with times from the operators' timetables.
patong.airportToPatongText: The Smart Bus leaves the airport about every 30 minutes and reaches the Patong stop (Provincial Electricity Authority) about {p1time} later, for {p1fare}. The dark blue Airport Bus Express also goes to Patong, every hour.
patong.patongToAirportText: Catch the Smart Bus at the Bangla Police Box stop. It takes about {inTime} to reach the airport.
patong.townPatongText: Smart Bus Route 2 runs between Bus Terminal 1 and Patong Beach for {p4fare}, about {p4time}.

faq.q: What is the cheapest way from Phuket Airport to Patong?
faq.a: The Smart Bus: {p1fare}, about {p1time}.

faq.q: Where do I get off in Patong?
faq.a: Coming from the airport, the Smart Bus stops at the Provincial Electricity Authority in Patong. Going back, catch it at the Bangla Police Box stop.

faq.q: Can I take a bus to the airport for an early flight?
faq.a: The first Smart Bus from Patong leaves at {inFirst} and reaches the airport at {inFirstArr}.

faq.q: How do I get from Patong to Phuket Old Town?
faq.a: Take Smart Bus Route 2 to Bus Terminal 1 ({p4fare}). The Old Town is a short walk from there, and the free Dragon Line loops it.

map.title: Phuket Bus Map 2026: All 5 Routes and Airport Bus Lines
map.description: A simple map of Phuket's 5 bus routes: Smart Bus, airport bus 8411, Airport Express, Town–Patong and the free Dragon Line. See which bus goes where.
map.intro: A simplified map of the five routes. It shows the order of stops and where the lines meet, not the exact roads. Pick a route for the full timetable.

faq.q: Is there a bus between Patong and Kata?
faq.a: Yes. The Smart Bus continues from Patong to Karon and Kata, for the same {p1fare}.

faq.q: Is there a bus from Patong to Kamala?
faq.a: Yes. Take the Smart Bus heading to the airport; it stops at Kamala and Surin after Patong.

faq.q: Do Phuket buses run at night?
faq.a: The last Smart Bus leaves the airport at {p1last}. The other routes stop between 19:00 and 22:30.
